facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected revoke_supported_quantity: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies tenant-revocable objects only and the signed approval scope.
facts.statement: the deployer review runs on 2026-06-15 and the revocation must be effective before it; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside tenant-revocable objects only and the signed approval scope.

options.consequence: order expedited role rollover would land Halyard's rollover on 2026-06-12 for register verification 2026-06-15, three days later than the tenant revocation, and adds USD 230; an expedited rollover needs the CISO, which AP-SO-0108 does not carry.
